parsed.explanation: A trans-specific criminal offence expressly bans dressing/posing as another sex and is enforced—documented detention, guilty plea, fine and default imprisonment—so presentation itself carries arrest/prosecution risk in public. Documents cannot be aligned locally, discrimination and police intimidation/forced-outing threats are documented, no independent organisations or effective recourse exist, and fear is reported with no assurance foreigners are exempt. Enforcement frequency appears sparse (one 2014 case, no known 2017 convictions) and the cross-dressing penalty is not capital; the de jure stoning provisions for same-sex conduct are secondary for a trans visitor and are under a revocable moratorium. Thus severe criminal exposure without the recurring sweeps/custody abuse of 0.15-0.25 profiles.
